editorial_note: The original news has not been copied verbatim. An original summary in simple language for Japanese learners has been created from information from reliable sources.

2026-09-15-chubu-electric-hamaoka-data-s.teaser: After the problem with earthquake-related data at the Hamaoka nuclear power plant, Chubu Electric has announced its decision to withdraw the restart applications for two reactors; its top executives will also resign.
explanation: A Reuters report on 14 September said Chubu Electric will withdraw its application for the safety review for restarting Reactors 3 and 4 at the Hamaoka nuclear power plant. A third-party investigation by the company found irregularities in the handling of earthquake-related data.
According to the report, the company's president and chairman will also resign. The company first wants to reform its organisation and governance, and then plans to apply again in the future.
For N3 learners, 再稼働, 審査申請, 取り下げる, 第三者調査 and 組織改革 are important words in business and government news.

2026-09-15-japan-iea-energy-security-coo.teaser: Prime Minister Takaichi and IEA Executive Director Fatih Birol said they would continue cooperating on global energy security, diversifying supply sources and supply-chain resilience for critical minerals.
explanation: According to a 14 September release from the Office of the Prime Minister of Japan, Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi met for about 15 minutes with Fatih Birol, Executive Director of the International Energy Agency (IEA), who was visiting Japan.

Japan explained its aim of making energy supply more stable and resilient through initiatives such as POWERR Asia and POWERR GX. The IEA also said it would work closely with Japan on global energy security and market stability.
The two sides also discussed diversifying sources of energy supply and strengthening the supply chain for critical minerals. At N3 level, 安全保障, 供給源, 多様化, 供給網 and 意見交換 are very useful.

2026-09-15-mount-fuji-offseason-rescue-f.teaser: Yamanashi Prefecture has announced a policy plan to charge fees for disaster-prevention helicopter rescues on Mount Fuji during the closed season, in order to reduce reckless climbing. Fees will be reduced or waived for climbers who submit a climbing plan and follow safety rules.
explanation: On 14 September, Yamanashi Prefecture released a policy package to reduce risky climbing on Mount Fuji during the closed season. One of its main measures is charging a fee for disaster-prevention helicopter rescue.

However, there is a plan to reduce or waive the fee for climbers who submit a climbing plan and take the necessary safety measures. A new climbing notification system and stronger entry controls and public awareness were also mentioned.
This is now implementation guidance; detailed rules will be drawn up taking in the views of the parties concerned. For N4/N3 learners, 閉山期, 救助, 手数料, 登山届, 減免 and 通行規制 are important.

vocab.閉山期: Season when the mountain / route is closed

2026-09-14-yen-speculators-net-long.teaser: Reuters reported that in the futures market, speculative investors moved to a net long position in the yen for the first time since February; expectations of a BOJ rate hike are one reason behind it.
explanation: A Reuters report on 13 September, citing CFTC data, said speculative investors' yen positions turned net long in the week ending 8 September — the first such change since February.

This means part of the market is taking positions on the view that the yen may strengthen further. The main reasons cited are expectations that the Bank of Japan may raise rates more quickly, and the possibility that Japanese investors may bring some money back home from abroad.
This does not guarantee future exchange rates; futures positions can change quickly. For N3 learners, 投機筋, 先物市場, 買い越し, 利上げ, 背景 and 可能性 are important words.

2026-09-14-okinawa-governor-election-koj.teaser: In the Okinawa gubernatorial election, Genta Koja, backed by the central government, won. The local economy and policy on US military bases were important issues in this election.
explanation: A Reuters report on 13 September said Genta Koja won the Okinawa gubernatorial election. He had the backing of Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's central government.

The large presence of US military bases in Okinawa has long been an important issue in local politics. At the same time, the local economy, development and relations with the central government also mattered in the vote.
This result could affect future relations between the Okinawa prefectural government and the Tokyo central government. For N3 learners, 知事選挙, 当選, 与党, 支援, 県政 and 注目 are useful words.

2026-09-14-yttrium-supply-japan.teaser: According to a Reuters analysis, supplies to Japan of yttrium, used in semiconductors and energy technology, are in a difficult state; China's export controls have increased pressure on the global supply chain.
explanation: A Reuters analysis on 13 September said yttrium, an important metal used in aerospace, semiconductors and energy technology, is one where China plays a very large role in global supply.
After China tightened export controls last year, supply pressure built up in various countries. The report said supplies to Japan have been especially limited since late last year.
This is a good example for understanding supply-chain risk. For N3 learners, 重要鉱物, 供給, 依存, 輸出管理, 調達, 在庫 and 確保 are important words in business and technology news.

2026-09-13-japan-houthi-attacks-navigati.teaser: The Japanese government condemned the recent attacks by Yemen's Houthi group and stressed the importance of ensuring civilian safety and free, safe passage for ships.
explanation: In a statement on 12 September, Japan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs again condemned the recent attacks by Yemen's Houthi group. The statement said obstructing civilians and facilities, and the free and safe passage of ships, is unacceptable.

Japan stated in particular that stability in Yemen and across the Middle East, and safe maritime passage through the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, are important for international trade and Japan's energy security. The government said it would work diplomatically with international partners to reduce tensions.
For learners, 攻撃, 非難, 航行, 妨げる, 安定, 安全保障 and 緊張緩和 are important words in international news and N3 reading.

2026-09-13-japan-iaea-general-conference.teaser: The IAEA's 70th General Conference will be held in Vienna from 14 to 18 September. Japan will speak on preventing the spread of nuclear weapons, the peaceful use of nuclear energy and cooperation with the IAEA.
explanation: Japan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced on 11 September that the IAEA's 70th General Conference will be held in Vienna, Austria, from 14 to 18 September, and that the Japanese government will send representatives.

Japan's statement will cover nuclear non-proliferation, the peaceful use of nuclear energy, addressing international challenges and support for IAEA initiatives. There will also be exchanges on expanding cooperation with various countries and organisations.
For learners, 総会, 代表, 出席, 核不拡散, 平和利用, 協力 and 意見交換 are very useful N4/N3 words in government and science news.

vocab.核不拡散: Preventing the spread of nuclear weapons

2026-09-13-pisa-2025-japan-results.teaser: According to the OECD's PISA 2025 country note, Japanese 15-year-old students scored above the OECD average in mathematics, reading and science.
explanation: According to the Japan country note published by the OECD on 8 September, in PISA 2025 Japanese 15-year-old students were above the OECD average in all three areas: mathematics, reading and science.

PISA is not just about memorised knowledge; it tests complex problem-solving, critical thinking, communication and the ability to apply knowledge and skills in real situations. More than 760,000 students from 91 countries and economies took part in the 2025 assessment.

Although the results were strong, the OECD country note says the gap between the highest- and lowest-scoring students in Japan widened in mathematics, reading and science between 2022 and 2025. So alongside the good headline results, this inequality aspect is also important.

2026-09-12-wholesale-inflation-august.teaser: In August, Japan's 企業物価 (producer prices) rose 7.6% compared with the same month a year earlier. With import costs also staying high, pressure on business costs continues.
explanation: A Reuters report on 11 September said Japan's August producer price index, or 企業物価指数, rose 7.6% compared with the same month a year earlier (前年同月比). The result was stronger than market forecasts.

The report also noted that import prices rose 24.8% compared with the same month a year earlier (前年同月比). When fuel and other import costs rise, companies may later pass that cost on to consumer prices — which is why 企業物価 is an important signal of future inflation.
For learners, 企業物価指数, 前年比, 輸入価格, 原材料, 利上げ and 影響 are very useful in economics and N3 news.

2026-09-12-kioxia-us-listing-ai.teaser: Japan's memory-chip maker Kioxia plans to list shares in the United States in ADS form. This could make the company more easily accessible to international AI investors.
explanation: A Reuters report on 11 September said Kioxia plans to list American Depositary Shares (ADS) in the United States. ADS are a mechanism that allows shares of foreign companies to be traded relatively easily on the US market.

An AI-focused fund manager at Voya Investment Management believes a U.S. listing could increase the liquidity of Kioxia's shares and bring the company more to the attention of global AI investors. This is one investor's assessment, not a guaranteed future outcome.
For learners, 半導体, 上場, 預託証券, 投資家, 売買, 株価 and 市場環境 are important N3 words in technology and economic news.

2026-09-12-iaea-fukushima-treated-water-.teaser: IAEA officials and experts from laboratories in China, South Korea and Switzerland collected samples of ALPS treated water at Fukushima Daiichi.
explanation: Japan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced on 11 September that IAEA officials and experts from third-party laboratories in China, South Korea and Switzerland collected samples at the Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Station.

The samples were taken from ALPS treated water before it was mixed with seawater. This additional monitoring arrangement has been running under the IAEA framework since September 2024; this was one of that continuing series of missions.
For learners, 専門家, 処理水, 採取, 測定, 安全性, 分析, 透明性 and 協力 are usable words in science and government news.

2026-09-11-boj-masu-rate-hike-risks.teaser: Bank of Japan policymaker Kazuyuki Masu has said the interest rate may need to be raised quickly if inflation becomes stronger.
explanation: In a speech in Fukui on 10 September, Bank of Japan policymaker Kazuyuki Masu said the policy interest rate may need to be raised quickly if inflationary pressure proves stronger than expected. Reuters also reported the main points of the same speech.

He said underlying, or 基調的, inflation is moving toward the bank's 2% target and the current monetary environment remains relatively accommodative. It is therefore important to decide at each policy meeting by looking at inflation, the economy and market conditions.
For learners, 物価上昇率, 金利, 利上げ, 金融政策決定会合, 水準 and 注目 are very important N3 words in economics and news.

2026-09-11-japan-north-korea-summit-abdu.teaser: The Japanese government has said it will firmly raise the long-standing issue of the abduction of Japanese citizens at the planned summit with North Korea.
explanation: A Reuters report on 10 September, quoting Japan's Chief Cabinet Secretary Minoru Kihara, said the government intends to firmly raise the long-standing unresolved issue of the abduction of Japanese citizens at the planned summit with North Korea.

The government's aim is to make progress on unresolved issues through leader-level talks. The report did not give a specific time for the meeting or a confirmed outcome, so it should be understood as an ongoing diplomatic process.
For learners, 首脳会談, 拉致問題, 課題, 対話, 前進, 具体的 and 成果 are widely used N3 words in politics and international news.

2026-09-11-shimada-uk-france-visit-resul.teaser: Japan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced that Tomoaki Shimada visited the United Kingdom and France from 6 to 9 September and discussed cultural exchange and cooperation with UNESCO.
explanation: An announcement of results by Japan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs on 10 September said Parliamentary Vice-Minister Tomoaki Shimada visited the United Kingdom and France from 6 to 9 September.

In London, he exchanged views on expanding cultural and public relations with Japan House London and representatives involved in Japan-UK exchange. In Paris, he visited UNESCO headquarters and also discussed Japan's World Heritage and international cooperation.
For learners, 訪問, 交流, 意見交換, 本部, 世界遺産, 発信 and 協力 are useful words in everyday news and N4/N3 reading.

2026-09-10-mount-fuji-landslide-heavy-ra.teaser: After heavy rain, a landslide occurred near a main entrance to Mount Fuji, and the Fuji Subaru Line was temporarily closed.
explanation: A Reuters report on 9 September said a landslide occurred near a main entrance to Mount Fuji after heavy rain in central Japan. According to local media, three cars were buried, but no injuries were reported in the incident.

Because of the heavy rain, some roads, including the Fuji Subaru Line, were closed. The same rain also brought reports of flooding and transport disruption in the Aichi and Gifu areas, so it is important to check local road and weather information before travelling.
For learners, 大雨, 土砂崩れ, 通行止め, 確認 and 最新情報 are very practical N4/N3 words in disaster and everyday safety news.

2026-09-10-japan-yields-domestic-investm.teaser: Fitch says that as yields on Japanese government bonds rise, domestic investment may become more attractive for banks and insurance companies.
explanation: A Reuters report on 9 September, citing an analysis by Fitch Ratings, said that if Japanese government bond yields rise, keeping money inside Japan could become relatively attractive for domestic banks, life insurers and other large investors.

With the yield on 10-year Japanese government bonds rising to a high level not seen in a long time, returns on domestic assets have increased. Fitch also believes the Bank of Japan may raise interest rates somewhat faster than the market expects — although this is not a confirmed decision.
For learners, 金利, 国債, 利回り, 国内投資, 資産, 利上げ and 注目 are very important N3 words in economic news.

2026-09-10-onishi-singapore-visit.teaser: Yohei Onishi, Parliamentary Vice-Minister for Foreign Affairs of Japan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs, will visit Singapore from 10 to 12 September and exchange views on bilateral relations and with representatives of Japanese companies.
explanation: Japan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced on 9 September that Parliamentary Vice-Minister for Foreign Affairs Yohei Onishi will visit Singapore from 10 to 12 September.

He will deliver closing remarks at the Japan-Singapore Symposium, meet senior officials of the Singapore government, and exchange views with representatives of Japanese companies. He is also scheduled to take part in a symposium related to the ASEAN Council of Japan Alumni during the trip.
For learners, 訪問, 出席, 政府高官, 会談, 意見交換, 関係者 and 両国関係 are widely used N4/N3 words in diplomacy and government news.

2026-09-09-japan-us-fx-policy-aligned.teaser: Japan's Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said Japan and the United States will maintain close communication to ensure orderly movements in the foreign-exchange market.
explanation: A Reuters report on 8 September said Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama stated that Japan and the United States will continue close coordination, as before, to maintain orderly movements in the foreign-exchange market.

He said the policy stance has not changed since the coordinated intervention in July. With the yen recently rising to a seven-month high, attention has grown on market volatility and future interest-rate policy.
For learners, 為替市場, 安定, 連携, 変動, 方針 and 利上げ are very important N3 words in economics and news.

2026-09-09-japanese-investors-foreign-eq.teaser: In August, Japanese investors bought foreign shares heavily but reduced investment in foreign bonds, Reuters reported, citing data from Japan's Ministry of Finance.
explanation: A Reuters report on 8 September, citing data from Japan's Ministry of Finance, said Japanese investors bought a net about 1.3 trillion yen of foreign shares in August — the largest foreign share buying in five months.

At the same time, they were net sellers of short-term and long-term foreign bonds. In other words, rather than pulling out of foreign assets entirely, they changed the balance of investment between shares and bonds.
For learners, 投資家, 海外株, 買い越し, 債券, 資産, 配分 and 業績 are important N3 words in market and business news.

vocab.買い越し: Net buying / buying more than selling

2026-09-09-japan-helicopters-indonesia-w.teaser: Japan is sending three CH-47 helicopters and a team of about 180 personnel to help control forest and land fires in Indonesia.
explanation: A Reuters report on 8 September, citing Indonesian defence officials, said Japan is sending three CH-47 Chinook transport helicopters and about 180 personnel.
The helicopters are due to arrive in Pontianak, West Kalimantan, on 9 September. After test flights, they are planned to help control the fires from 12 to 19 September.
From this news, you can learn 山火事, 消火, 支援, 派遣, 隊員, 到着 and 活動 — very practical N4/N3 words related to disasters and government assistance.

vocab.隊員: Team member / member of a force

2026-09-08-kunimitsu-bhutan-india-visit.teaser: Japan's State Minister for Foreign Affairs, Ayano Kunimitsu, is visiting Bhutan and India from 8 to 13 September. Marking 40 years of diplomatic relations with Bhutan and inspecting economic cooperation projects in Kolkata are part of the trip.
explanation: An announcement by Japan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs on 7 September said State Minister for Foreign Affairs Ayano Kunimitsu will leave Tokyo on 8 September to visit Bhutan and India, and return to Japan on 13 September.

In Bhutan, there will be exchanges on further strengthening ties with the royal family and government officials, marking the 40th anniversary of the establishment of Japan-Bhutan diplomatic relations. In India, she will inspect the site of a Japanese economic cooperation project in Kolkata.
For learners, 訪問, 外交関係, 周年, 関係強化, 意見交換, 経済協力 and 視察 are words widely used in diplomacy and government news.

2026-09-08-foreign-reserves-record-drop.teaser: In August, Japan's foreign-exchange reserves fell by a record amount. Large-scale market intervention to support the yen was the main reason.
explanation: A Reuters report on 7 September, citing data from Japan's Ministry of Finance, said foreign-exchange reserves fell by about 79.6 billion dollars in August to 1.208 trillion dollars — a record in terms of monthly decline.

The main reason was large-scale foreign-exchange market intervention — selling dollars and buying yen to counter the yen's weakness. Such a step can reduce the foreign securities and dollar assets held by the government.
From this news, you can learn 外貨準備高, 前月, 円安, 為替介入, 資産 and 安定 — important N3 words for the economy and currency markets.

vocab.為替介入: Government intervention in the currency market

2026-09-08-kura-sushi-chiikawa-campaign.teaser: Japan's Kura Sushi ended its popular Chiikawa character campaign midway. The decision was taken after it came to light that some employees had sold free products online.
explanation: Reuters reported that Japan's major sushi chain Kura Sushi ended its campaign with the popular 'Chiikawa' characters earlier than scheduled.
The stated reason was that some employees were found to have resold the campaign's free products online. The company began taking action on the matter and stopped the campaign.
This news is good for learning everyday business Japanese: 従業員, 無料, 販売, 対応, 中止, 人気 and 企画 are useful in conversations about shops, work and business.

2026-09-07-mydocomo-maintenance.teaser: NTTドコモ will carry out maintenance on some My docomo services from tonight. Payments, viewing payment status and some account information will be temporarily unavailable at certain times.
explanation: On the night of 7 September, NTTドコモ will carry out system maintenance on several parts of My docomo. From 9:30 p.m., paying bills on a PC, checking payment status and using Pay-easy will be temporarily unavailable.

From 10:30 p.m., some information on the My docomo top page — such as usage charges, points, contract details and data usage — will also be unavailable. Many of the affected services are expected to resume around 6 a.m. on 8 September.
For learners, 今夜, 一部, 一時停止, 支払, 確認, 機能 and 予定 are very useful in everyday notices and service-related Japanese.

2026-09-07-jins-osaka-myopia-astigmatism.teaser: JINS and Osaka University conducted research on myopia and astigmatism using a large dataset of eyeglass sales from across the country; the two papers were published in the journal IOVS.
explanation: JINS and the Osaka University Graduate School of Medicine jointly researched refractive status — the state of how the eye refracts light — using anonymised big data from eyeglass sales. Two papers on myopia and astigmatism were published in IOVS.

The myopia analysis used anonymised data from about 4.52 million people aged 6-35. According to information published by the company, an even larger dataset was used in the astigmatism research. This is research based on JINS customer data, so the results should not be assumed to be exactly the same for the whole Japanese population.
From this news, you can learn 近視, 乱視, 大規模, 匿名, 分析, 論文 and 掲載 — important N3 words used in research and health-science news.

2026-09-07-special-advisor-australia-new.teaser: A special adviser to Japan's Prime Minister will visit Australia and French New Caledonia from 7 to 12 September and exchange views on bilateral relations and the regional situation.
explanation: Japan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced that a special adviser to the Prime Minister will visit Australia and French New Caledonia from 7 to 12 September — in other words, the trip is due to start today.

There, he will exchange views on bilateral relations and the regional situation with relevant people, including representatives of the government and the military. This is an example of Japan's diplomatic outreach in the Indo-Pacific region.
For learners, 首相特別顧問, 訪問, 現地, 関係者, 二国間関係, 情勢, 意見交換 and 連携 are very useful N3-level words in news and diplomatic Japanese.

vocab.首相特別顧問: Special adviser to the Prime Minister

2026-09-06-pacific-heavy-rain.teaser: Today, the autumn rain front is moving north. Rain is expected over a wide area on the Pacific side of western and eastern Japan, with heavy rain possible in some areas at night.
explanation: On 6 September, the 秋雨前線 (autumn rain front) near Japan's southern coast is moving north. Under its influence, rain is forecast over a large area on the Pacific side, from western Japan to eastern Japan.
From southern Kanto to southern Kinki, rain is expected to intensify toward night, with a risk of heavy rain. If you go out, it is helpful to check local weather updates and transport conditions.
For learners, 前線, 北上, 見込み, 大雨 and 気象情報 are very common and practical words in weather news.

2026-09-06-japan-us-investment-progress.teaser: Talks are progressing on the 550 billion dollar Japan-US investment framework, with AI and semiconductor projects seen as key areas.
explanation: Japan's trade minister, Ryosei Akazawa, said talks are progressing on the 550 billion dollar investment initiative with the United States. This framework is an important part of last year's trade agreement.
Projects related to resources, energy and power plants have already been announced. He said AI and semiconductor projects will receive major emphasis in the talks ahead.
From this news, you can learn 投資枠, 協議, 半導体, 双方 and 方針 — important N3-level words used in business and government policy news.

2026-09-06-osaka-us-open-last-16.teaser: Japan's Naomi Osaka beat Elise Mertens in a three-set battle to reach the last 16, the fourth round, of the US Open.
explanation: Naomi Osaka beat Belgium's Elise Mertens 6-3, 3-6, 7-5 in the third round of the US Open to advance to the fourth round.
The match went to three sets, and the final set was also very competitive. Osaka closed out the match by winning an important game near the end.
For reading sports news, 選手, 試合, 勝つ, 接戦, 終盤 and 回戦 are very practical N4/N3 words.

2026-09-05-household-spending-falls.teaser: In July, real household spending in Japan fell 3.6% from a year earlier; high prices are putting pressure on consumer spending.
explanation: In July 2026, spending by Japanese households fell 3.6% compared with the same month a year earlier. It was the eighth consecutive month of year-on-year decline.
Spending fell in some categories, including food and transport. With inflation high, many households appear to be choosing their necessary spending carefully even as incomes rise.

On a monthly basis, spending rose 0.5%. The picture is therefore not entirely one-directional; consumer spending trends are also seen as important information for the Bank of Japan's interest-rate decisions.

2026-09-05-katayama-cabinet-continuity.teaser: Reuters reported that there is also a plan to keep Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama in her post in the upcoming cabinet reshuffle.
explanation: A source-based Reuters report said there is a plan to keep Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama in her role in a possible cabinet reshuffle in September.

Katayama has played an important role in foreign-exchange policy, public finances and economic talks with the United States. Keeping her in the post could therefore be seen as a signal of policy continuity.
This is not an announced final appointment; in 'sources say' reports, the later official decision may differ. For learners, 内閣改造, 続投, 財政 and 人事 are especially useful words here.

2026-09-05-tokyo-data-centres-deal.teaser: Singapore's Keppel group has planned to take large stakes in two data centres in Tokyo with an investment of about 190 billion yen.
explanation: Singapore-based Keppel DC REIT and Keppel have announced an agreement to take large stakes in two data centres in Tokyo, in transactions totalling about 190 billion yen.
The company said that once this acquisition is completed, the share of rental income that Keppel DC REIT earns from Japan will increase significantly.
As the use of AI and cloud services spreads, demand for data centres is also growing. This news is therefore useful for learning about three topics: technology, infrastructure and foreign investment.

2026-09-04-japan-budget-requests.teaser: Budget requests from Japanese government agencies for the next fiscal year have reached 143.1 trillion yen.
explanation: Japan's various ministries and government agencies have submitted preliminary requests for how much money they will need in the next fiscal year. In total, the amount is 143.1 trillion yen.

One major reason for the large amount is a plan to increase investment in strategic sectors such as AI, semiconductors and economic security. At the same time, interest and repayment costs on government debt have also risen.
This is not yet the final budget. After the Ministry of Finance examines the requests, the process of finalising the budget will move forward at the end of the year.

2026-09-04-yen-strong-week.teaser: The yen strengthened through the week on expectations that the Bank of Japan may raise interest rates.
explanation: The yen was on course to strengthen by about 2.5% against the dollar this week — one of its biggest weekly gains in more than a month.
As a main reason, expectations grew in the market that the Bank of Japan (BOJ) may raise interest rates. The prospect of higher rates can affect demand for a country's currency.
Japanese currency officials have also said they are watching exchange rates. The BOJ's policy meeting and US economic data will therefore be important ahead.

2026-09-04-nikkei-rises.teaser: On Friday, Japan's Nikkei index rose 0.8%; several other Asian markets also gained.
explanation: On Friday, the mood in Asian stock markets was broadly positive. Japan's Nikkei average rose 0.8% at one point during the day.
Investors were watching US jobs data, the outlook for central bank interest-rate policy, and movements in the yen. These factors can also affect Japan's stock market.
A single day's index does not reveal the long-term state of the economy — for learners, the main point here is the common Japanese vocabulary related to markets.

2026-09-03-japan-services-pmi.teaser: Japan's services sector expanded in August at the fastest pace in five months, a private survey suggested.
explanation: A private survey found that activity in Japan's services sector grew in August at the fastest pace in five months.
The survey suggested that business activity and new work increased as domestic demand strengthened.
The word 'サービス業' is very important. Restaurants, travel, financial services and many other kinds of service-based work beyond manufacturing goods fall under it.
